title: One-to-One Relationships Conventions
description: Learn the convention for automatic one-to-one relationship configuration.

data.text: EF Core introduced default conventions for one-to-one relationships (EF 6.x does not support this). A one-to-one relationship requires reference navigation properties at both sides.

data.title: One-to-One Convention
data.content: Student and StudentAddress entities with one-to-one relationship

data.title: Unique Index
data.text: EF Core creates a unique index on the NotNull foreign key column `StudentId` to ensure uniqueness for one-to-one relationships.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Reference navigation properties required at both sides
Foreign key property in dependent entity
EF Core supports this (EF 6.x does not)
data.takeaway: Continue to learn Fluent API configuration for one-to-one relationships.
